subject: Deku Tree
text: A Heart Container is found after finishing the Deku Tree and defeating Queen Gohma at the end of the dungeon.

evidence.quote: You will find this after finishing the...Deku Tree and defeating the evil queen...Gohma at the end of the dungeon.

subject: Dodongo Cavern
text: A Heart Container is acquired after completing the Dodongo Cavern on Death Mountain by beating the boss.

evidence.quote: This is acquired after you complete...the Dodongo Cavern on Death Mountain,...just beat the boss and there it is.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Defeating the boss inside Jabu-Jabu's belly causes a Heart Container to appear on the ground.

evidence.quote: Defeat the boss Inside Jabu-Jabu's...belly and the Heart Container will...appear on the ground once it is dead.

subject: Forest Temple
text: A Heart Container is left sitting on the ground after defeating the boss inside of the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Defeat the boss inside of the Forest...Temple and this will be sitting there...on the ground just waiting for you.
